description: Total cost of employing someone on a gross salary: the salary plus employer social security, payroll taxes, pension and other on-costs, with a breakdown, for the current tax year. Countries: ee, pl, dk, sg, nl, es, de, us, uk, au, nz, ca, ie, in. region is REQUIRED for: us, au, ca; optional for: es, de, in; a missing or unknown region returns the valid codes. Returns the tax year, official source URLs and the calcbloc.com page. Bonus and other supplemental pay (withholding vs final tax): calculate_supplemental_withholding (sg, fr, nl, es, de, us, uk, au, nz, ca, ie, in). Equity compensation (RSUs, stock options): calculate_equity_tax (us, uk, au, ca, in). Equity earned while working in several countries: calculate_cross_border_equity (tax estimates for sg, nl, es, de, us, uk, au, ca, ie, in). Not yet supported: cross-border salary withholding (multi-country payroll), and the double-tax relief amount (get_tax_treaties lists the treaty withholding limits CalcBloc stores).

country.description: Country short code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in lower case; the UK is "uk", "gb" also works), e.g. "us", "uk", "ca", "de", "in", "au", "nz", or the English name. Older keys such as "new-zealand" also work. See list_countries.

gross_salary.description: Gross salary before tax in the country's currency. Annual for every country except Singapore (monthly); India: annual CTC/gross as described by list_countries.

options.description: Country-specific options. Examples: US {"filing_status":"mfj","children":2} (filing_status: single | mfj | hoh; "married" and "head_of_household" are accepted too), UK {"pension_pct":5,"student_loan":"plan2"} (student_loan: none | plan1 | plan2 | plan4 | plan5), Germany {"tax_class":3,"church":true}. Call list_countries with the country to see every option, its allowed values and its default.

region.description: Region code or name. Required for: us, au, ca. Examples: US "ca", Australia "nsw", Canada "on". list_countries with the country lists every code.

year.description: Tax year, e.g. "2026" or "2026-27". Default: the current year. Calculations use the current year only.

name: calculate_employer_cost

attribution.description: Always "Data by CalcBloc"; show it with the figures.

calcblocUrl.description: The calcbloc.com page for this result.

sources.description: Official sources for the rates used.

retrievedAt.description: Date CalcBloc last checked the source.

label.description: The status in words, to show with the figures.

urls.description: The official worked example(s), or the law texts the check was worked from.

verification.description: API 1.10+: how the calculation is verified, for countries on CalcBloc's shared take-home engine: official-example (the tests reproduce a worked example published by the tax authority or social security institution) or law-text (no official example is published; the tests are worked by hand from the law). Null for countries with their own engine.
